## Activity

During February 2019, Market Eye Clinic recorded 371 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. The activity total is presented for routine operational monitoring and should be read alongside the number of images suitable for assessment and the grading outcomes recorded during the same reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 15 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.0. This measure indicates the proportion of the reported activity for which the images could not be used for grading. The count and rate are included together to support review of image quality and to provide a consistent summary of the clinic’s performance for February 2019.

## Grading

A total of 58 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 7. This records the midpoint of the reported waiting time for grading and is provided with the referable result count as part of the routine site operations summary. Together, these figures describe the grading activity associated with the 371 captures completed at Market Eye Clinic during February 2019.
